name: RealmsMUD core-lib
english_description: The official mudlib of RealmsMUD, a modern MySQL-backed FluffOS/LDMud-dialect engine with a substantial shipped game world (guilds, areas, quests, research/crafting systems). Porting it surfaced an unusually deep chain of FluffOS-compat bugs that each masked the next: add_action()'s command_giver-at-call-time requirement silently no-op'd every player's command registration when it ran (as upstream intended) from create() before exec() attached the real connection; this driver's strsrch() 3rd argument is a direction flag, not a start offset, which corrupted a hand-built regreplace()/regexplode() shim's multi-match handling and produced malformed command regexes; this driver's legacy regexp() efun hard-caps at 10 capture groups, breaking dispatch for any command with several flag aliases (switched command matching to pcre_match()); and LDMud's save_value()/restore_value() (absent here) were a hard compile error in the item base class, breaking every item in the game until a from-scratch LPC-literal serializer/parser was written. A MySQL 8.0 instance (provisioned locally, not part of the shipped repo) backs the login/player-account persistence layer.
